auditor.independence: Independent auditor: did not author the translations. The translator was the PR's coder session (commit 44f676535, session 306dec1075ff); this audit was a separate agent run and only corrected strings it rejected.

head: 44f676535c3e5b14ad6fca963c28c266df2bfb3b
scope: Independent audit of all 77 ui.chat.remote_compute keys in es: glossary, the es style guide, claim-sensitive binding/tier copy, placeholders, CLDR plural categories, RTL/bidi and cell budgets. Rejected strings corrected in-place; residual findings counted below.

claim_check.binding: recorded + not enforced, and no isolated/secured/segmented/private claim, in every locale
claim_check.recorded_sentence: the sheet sentence states the run is recorded against the network and that access is not restricted by it in this version

corrections.reason: prompt is on the es guide's kept-English list; corpus uses 'prompt' 30x and keeps 'mensaje' for a sent message

corrections.from: El compositor está vacío; una ejecución necesita un mensaje.
corrections.to: El compositor está vacío; una ejecución necesita un prompt.

corrections.from: Escribe primero un mensaje en el compositor.
corrections.to: Escribe primero un prompt en el compositor.

corrections.from: Radient: inicia sesión para ejecutar el mensaje de esta conversación en capacidad alquilada. Al seleccionar esta fila se inicia la sesión.
corrections.to: Radient: inicia sesión para ejecutar el prompt de esta conversación en capacidad alquilada. Al seleccionar esta fila se inicia la sesión.

corrections.reason: es guide: push stays English ('Hacer pull ahora' pattern); 'subir' is the corpus's upload verb and would read as upload

corrections.from: La ejecución empezaría en un commit que no está en ningún remoto. Sube la rama y vuelve a iniciar la ejecución.
corrections.to: La ejecución empezaría en un commit que no está en ningún remoto. Haz push de la rama y vuelve a iniciar la ejecución.

corrections.reason: one English word 'deployment' had two renderings in the namespace; 'despliegue' is the one the sibling sentence already uses

corrections.from: Radient: esta implementación no ofrece computación remota.
corrections.to: Radient: este despliegue no ofrece computación remota.

nit.issue: 'para usarlo' has no antecedent gender in a chip whose noun is unnamed; understandable, left as the terser reading.
'no aplicada' mirrors the fr call: the claim is right (recorded, not enforced) but the participle's subject is implicit.

notes: Severity counts are the RESIDUAL findings on the corrected bytes. Strings this audit rejected were corrected in the same commit and are listed under corrections; they are not counted as unresolved.
